PREFIX brick: <http://brickschema.org/schema/1.2/brick#>
PREFIX ref: <http://w3.org/ns/ref#>
SELECT ?n ?label ?ts
WHERE {
  ?z brick:hasSubentity ?n .
  ?z rdf:type brick:Zone .
  ?z brick:hasIdentifier "Perimeter_bot_ZN_1" .
  ?n rdf:type ?t .
  OPTIONAL { ?n ref:hasTimeseriesId ?ts }
  BIND(str(?n) as ?label)
}
